highlights: **Performance:** MCP tools avoid reading the caller's full thread, user-message lookups use their index, and reopening finished command rows reuses output instead of fetching it again.

**Agent reliability:** Provider switches hand off started cancelled runs, Cursor steering keeps interrupted prompts, and Claude monitoring avoids per-line completion alerts. Codex usage reset times survive first-request limits.

**OpenCode and usage:** Native OpenCode goals and todo updates appear across clients. Muse Code limits and more xAI/Antigravity accounts can be read through CLIProxyAPI; Pi waiting steers and model selection are clearer.

**Mobile:** Choose a voice environment once, then its method. Larger image attachments avoid a BigInt crash; command text is highlighted, Android window layouts keep their sidebar space, and iPad headers fit correctly.

**Links and previews:** File citations open the intended file and first line of a range. Attachment previews persist during preparation, HTML previews stay anchored, and sent ordered lists retain their written numbers.
**Navigation:** Drag command-palette threads into the composer, bind a shortcut to regenerate titles, use menus for older unloaded threads, and return focus when closing the right panel.

**Remote and shutdown:** Concurrent SSH launches sharing a T3 home reuse one server. Quitting stops leftover device daemons, desktop window teardown handles input safely, and proxy 403s are not mislabeled as rate limits.
**Projects:** Linked repositories retain their identity during refresh, removed worktrees keep project skills available, and blank .gitignore lines no longer drop new files from checkpoints.
